label: Runtime enumeration is split six-versus-eight and the six-name line is stale: README.md:16 names six runtimes while README.md:184 names eight; disk carries eight runtime directories (.claude .codex .cursor .devin .dsh .opencode .pi .vibe), so README.md:16 is missing DeepSeek Harness and Mistral Vibe.

The bridge self-dispatch rule is stated two incompatible ways and the later statement is wrong: README.md:73 says cli-pi and cli-deepseek-harness do not refuse, README.md:873 says every bridge but cli-pi refuses. cli-pi/SKILL.md:11 confirms the Pi exemption, and the dsh bridge's 13 hard-rules contain no self-dispatch refusal, so README.md:73 is correct and README.md:873 overstates by one.

The Node requirement is over-narrow and over-loose: README.md:164 says Node.js 24, but both built packages declare ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1, so 22 and 26 are supported and 24.x below 24.22.1 is not.

.dsh is absent from both runtime-folder enumerations: README.md:871 links six runtime READMEs and README.md:1618 lists six runtime folders plus .vibe, and neither names .dsh even though DeepSeek Harness is a supported runtime with a directory.

sk-design is the one skill in the library with no top-level README.md: .skilled/skills/sk-design holds only nested mode READMEs, so the §9 sk-design row at README.md:913 has no README for Q5's shrink map to link to until one is written.

The §4 doctor list reads as complete but omits six of seventeen: README.md:234 frames the list as the rest of the commands, yet /doctor:speckit, /doctor:mcp, /doctor:git, /doctor:sk-code, /doctor:deep-loop and /doctor:env are absent while §12 confirms seventeen.

The 45-command claim at README.md:1174 is correct and must not be changed: 43 in six groups (SPEC KIT 5 + CONTINUITY 3 + CREATE 13 + DEEP 2 + DESIGN 3 + DOCTOR 17) plus 2 utilities reconcile exactly; the apparent 46 on disk comes from two untracked operator-local commands that git ls-files excludes.

The 14-skill count is correct for the shipped repository and Q5's README count needs one correction: the fifteenth .skilled/skills entry is local-webflow, an untracked symlink to a private external checkout, so the 14 top-level READMEs are 13 shipped skills plus that symlink and exclude sk-design, which has none.

Every other numeric claim checked reconciles: 15 templates, 10 repo-rule files, 27 hook cores (12+6+8+shared), 17 doctor commands split 11+6, 15 sk-doc modes, 8 mcp-tooling modes, 8 bridges with 13 dsh hard rules, 14 Code Mode manuals with 7 described, and 9 advisor commands (4 advisor_* + 5 skill_graph_*).

The §15 agnostic-skill table is the most accurate skill list in the document: its 13 rows plus sk-code reconcile to 14, it names sk-design in full, and it is the only place stating the private local-<name> surface convention, so it is a better canonical source for the rewrite than §9.
